author: feature-implementer
summary: Clamped the /owners page request param to a minimum of 1 so a page value below the first renders the first page (HTTP 200) instead of the error page. Cause: findPaginatedForOwnersLastName built PageRequest.of(page - 1, pageSize) from the raw param, so page <= 0 produced a negative index and PageRequest.of threw IllegalArgumentException. Fix is one clamp in processFindForm feeding both the repository query and the pagination model; GET /owners is the only paged path in OwnerController. Covered by processFindFormWithPageBelowOneShowsFirstPage, parameterized over 0 and -5, confirmed red before the fix.

author: test-reviewer

findings.description: Test method name `processFindFormWithPageBelowOneShowsFirstPage` names the production method under test, not the resulting behavior. testing-principles.md § Test Naming mandates the BDD school `the{Subject}Should{Outcome}` for tests written or modified from 2026-07-31 onward; this test is new as of this slice, so the rule applies even though its neighbors (written earlier) keep the old `processXxx` style.
findings.fix: Rename to something like `theOwnerSearchShouldClampPageBelowOneToFirstPage` (or similar Subject/Outcome phrasing) so the name states what must be true afterward rather than which controller method is exercised.

approved_aspects: Choosing @ParameterizedTest(@ValueSource) over the neighboring for-loop pattern is correct: testing-principles.md § Test Naming explicitly prescribes 'data-driven via table or CSV source' for parameterized cases, and that rule (dated 2026-07-31) outranks the older loop precedent in processFindFormIgnoresSurroundingWhitespace, which predates the school and was not touched by this slice.

Test asserts real, distinct observable outcomes: HTTP 200 + view name + currentPage model attribute (the rendered page), and separately the zero-based Pageable index actually sent to the repository (the mechanism the bug fix touches) -- not a redundant verify() restating an assertion already made.
Both boundary values (0 and a negative number) are covered, matching the fix's Math.max clamp; confirmed the parameterized test passes and the underlying suite is green (./gradlew test).

author: change-grader
summary: clamp owners page param to the first page

blast_radius.note: Two files in one module, seven hunks, no sensitive paths; the production edit is confined to OwnerController.processFindForm and the private helpers it already called, and the only externally visible shift is that GET /owners?page<1 now renders the list instead of the error page.

semantic_surprise.note: Read every hunk: Math.max(page, FIRST_PAGE) is a floor with FIRST_PAGE=1, so PageRequest.of(page-1, size) sees index 0 at worst and no off-by-one is introduced; both downstream consumers (findPaginatedForOwnersLastName and addPaginationModel) take the clamped local, grep confirms no raw page survives in the method, and no upper bound was added so high-page behavior is untouched.

test_adequacy.note: The parameterized test drives real MVC dispatch over 0 and -5 and asserts observable outcomes on both sides of the fix -- HTTP 200, the ownersList view, currentPage=1 in the model, and a captured Pageable whose page number is 0 -- so it would fail against the unfixed controller, which threw IllegalArgumentException on a negative index, and against a clamp that fed the model a different page than the query.

reviewer_hedging.note: Both dispatched reviewers ended at approved with empty findings; doc-reviewer and security-reviewer are null because the review plan explicitly scoped them out, which is expected rather than silence, and the single changes_requested round was a cosmetic BDD test-method rename resolved exactly as proposed with no assertion or behavior reworked under pressure.

scope_deviation.note: Zero build retries, zero consultations, zero design revisions; the diff matches the reported bug surface exactly -- one clamp plus its boundary test -- with no opportunistic refactoring of the surrounding controller.

rationale: Read all seven hunks: the clamp is a correct floor, both downstream call sites consume it, and no raw page value survives in the method. The new test fails against the unfixed code. Worth noting for a follow-up: VetController.showVetList carries the identical unfixed defect at line 61.
